standard_prerequisites: The coproduct type with its constructors and its elimination principle.
The empty type and its elimination rule.
The code family on the coproduct defined by recursion, with the fixed endpoint element (retained context).
Transport along a path in a type family; based path induction with its conversion rule.
core_obligations: Construct the encode function by transporting reflexivity along the given path in the code family.
Construct the decode function by coproduct elimination: on the left component apply the injection map to the code, on the right component eliminate the empty code.

Prove that encode and decode are quasi-inverses at every point of the coproduct: the first direction by based path induction with a definitional chain, the second by case analysis with a transport computation chain.
proof_roadmap: Define encode of a pair by transporting reflexivity in the code family; observe the reflexivity code is definitionally the loop code at the fixed endpoint.
Define decode by dividing on the coproduct: the left case sends the code to the injection of it, the right case eliminates the empty type.

First quasi-inverse direction: by based path induction reduce the point to the injection of the fixed endpoint and the path to reflexivity, then close by a definitional chain evaluating decode of encode.

Second quasi-inverse direction: divide on the point; in the left case compute the transport chain, rewriting the composite-family transport by the author's composite-transport lemma and the pre-post composition computation, then simplify; in the right case the code is empty.
difficulty_reason: Full encode-decode construction with two quasi-inverse directions, coproduct and empty-type elimination, and a multi-step transport computation chain; the care point is doing the induction for all points at once so the coproduct elimination applies.
